Commentary.Commentary: Right then that is all we have from this game Action in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup Qualifier B continues on Tuesday, the 12th of July. Zimbabwe takes on Jersey and that match will begin at 1 pm IST (7.30 am GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Do join us then, take care and goodbye!
Sikandar Raza has been adjudged as the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his scintillating knock of 87 runs.

Earlier in the game, on the back of some sensational hitting by the Zimbabwe batters especially Sikandar Raza, the home side posted a mammoth total of 236 runs on the board. The Singapore bowlers had no answer to the onslaught and once they came out to bat, it was a tall order for them. The inexperienced batters crumbled under pressure with only Aryaman Sunil and Janak Prakash making contributions in the middle. A big win for the home team but all is not lost for Singapore.

Singapore must know that if they are to perform at the highest level, they can not put up a bowling performance like the one they did here against a side that has its own share of troubles. Singapore do have some positives to take from the game. Some of the bowlers showed some sign of control, especially Anantha Krishna who was probably the only bowler not taken to the cleaners. Aryaman Sunil showed ability with both ball and bat and Janak Prakash showed why a lot of hopes have been pinned on him by staying unbeaten till the end.

The hosts would be very happy with their overall performance. The bowlers bowled a tight line and with the scoreboard pressure building on the batters, they were in total command. All of them bowled economically and Tendai Chatara was the pick of the lot. He ended up with 3 wickets and conceded only 14 runs in his full quota of 4 overs. Blessing Muzarabani did well to chip in with 2 wickets of his own. However, it was their performance in the first innings that sealed the game for them. The top order combined wonderfully to put up a large total that was realistically impossible for Singapore to achieve.

This has been quite a one sided affair and the inexperience of the Singapore batting line up came to the fore here. It was stiff target to chase and at no point did they look like they would achieve it as they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. In the end they lost by a massive margin of 111 runs.
That's it, Zimbabwe have won! This is a bit shorter and outside off, Janak Prakash cuts it down to deep backward point for just a single. Zimbabwe win by a massive 111 runs!
Full and wide, this is firmly driven through covers for one.

OUT! BOWLED! You miss and I hit, Tendai Chatara knocks over Vinoth Baskaran and picks up his third wicket of the game. Chatara goes a bit fuller and attacks the stumps, Vinoth Baskaran makes room and looks to go big downtown. Baskaran ends up completely missing the ball and the ball castles into the middle stump.
Anantha Krishna is the new man in.
WIDE! This is banged in short and on leg stump, the ball flies over the batter's head and a wide is called.
Back of a length and around off, Vinoth Baskaran looks to swing across the line but misses.

Valiant effort from the man at 45 but he can't get to it. Shorter in length, on the pads. Vinoth Baskaran gets cramped for room as he tries to pull it away. The ball goes off the top edge and falls over the man at short fine leg. They pick up a couple of runs.

Tendai Chatara starts off with a slower short ball around middle. Janak Prakash tries to pull it aerially but does so without much timing. Wesley Madhevere races in from the mid-wicket fence but the ball falls short. Just the single then.
At the stumps, this is heaved away by Janak Prakash towards deep mid-wicket for just a single. Just one over remains then between Zimbabwe and a resounding victory.
Swing and a miss! Slower delivery, fuller and around off, Prakash looks to swing across the line but fails to connect.
WIDE! Banged in short and over middle, just a bit too short this time and a wide is called.
Vinoth Baskaran is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Another slower delivery from Blessing Muzarabani, bowled into the pitch and around off. Aryaman Sunil backs away looking to carve it over point but is way too early in the shot. The ball pops up off the top edge and goes high around leg stump. The keeper starts coming in but the bowler calls for it and takes a simple catch. Blessing Muzarabani gets his second wicket of the game.
Shorter in length again but its pace on this time, over middle and leg. Aryaman Sunil looks to pull but is beaten for pace this time.

Another slower delivery, this time bowled into the deck and angled into the body. Sunil looks to hook but takes his eyes off the ball and gets struck on the helmet. The umpires call out the physio for the mandatory concussion check. Everything seems to be fine and Sunil is good to continue.
A well-executed slower delivery from Blessing Muzarabani, full and around off. Aryaman Sunil has a swipe across the line but gets undone by the lack of pace.
Slower one, bowled into the pitch and outside off. Sunil waits for it and taps it past cover-point for a single.
WIDE! Tries to attack the pads but drifts it down the leg side. Wided!
Around off this is played through covers for a single.
Nicely bowled! Nails the yorker around leg stump, Prakash looks to jam it out but gets beaten.
Back of a length, on middle and this is swung away towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Two dots in a row now! Slower bumper this time, on off and Prakash fails to get it away.
Good comeback delivery from Jongwe! This is banged in short and over middle, Prakash looks to take it on but misses.
No ball! Luke Jongwe serves a high full toss on the body, Janak Prakash pulls it away behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs. No ball called for height and a free hit will follow.
Goes a touch fuller and pushes it wider, a huge swing and a miss from Aryaman Sunil.
No harm done! Length ball from Blessing Muzarabani, around off and Prakash can only manage to pull it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
No ball! Oh, dear! Blessing Muzarabani serves a really high full toss at the body, Prakash hits tries to get it away but fails to do so. Free Hit to follow.
SIX! Clean strike from Janak Prakash! Tries to bowl full and straight but serves it in the slot, Prakash frees his arms and thumps it right back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Full and straight again. this is heaved away towards wide long on for just a single.
Very full and tailing into leg stump, Aryaman Sunil looks to jam it out but gets an inside edge back onto the pads.

Hit hard and dropped! Full and straight, Janak Prakash drills it back towards the bowler. Blessing Muzarabani does well to get his hands around his face but cannot hang on to the catch. It was hit really hard, the batters pick up a single.
A length ball, around off, this is driven straight towards cover.

Sean Williams gets in the direct hit but Janak Prakash has made his ground! Around off, this is lofted on the bounce towards extra cover and the batters set off for the quick single. The direct hit comes in at the bowler's end but the umpire says that the batter is home.
Another short ball, at good height and angled in from around off. Prakash gets beaten for pace once again.
Short of a length and bowled with some good pace behind it, over off stump. Janak Prakash looks to pull it away but misses.
Goes fuller this time and at the stumps, this is driven towards wide long on for a couple of runs.
This is short and outside off, Prakash looks to uppercut it but misses.
Ryan Burl bowls the full outside off, Janak Prakash hits this hard to the right of cover for a single.
Fraction short and in line with the stumps, Aryaman Sunil goes back and knocks it towards long off for a single.
SIX! Powerfully struck! Tossed up around off, Aryaman Sunil picks up the wrong 'un and slog-sweeps it with the turn way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
WIDE! Straying down leg side with a full delivery. The batter misses the line and so does the keeper. Get an extra run along with the wide.
This one is floated full on the pads, Aryaman Sunil works this to long on for a single.
Connects the sweep this time. Ryan Burl goes full and on middle, Aryaman Sunil gets this to deep square leg and some good combination fielding in the deep allows the batters to get only two runs.
Full once again outside off, Aryaman Sunil taps this back to the bowler.
Flights this full outside off, Aryaman Sunil looks to heave this leg side and misses the line of the ball. Gets hit on the body for his efforts.
This is fired in full and on off stump, Sunil drills it to the right of Raza and gets a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Prakash drives it uppishly past a diving Sikandar Raza and picks up a single down to long on.
This is short and on off stump, Sunil pulls it uppishly towards the man at deep mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Quicker and flatter, turning it into middle. Sunil nudges it to the right of the bowler.
SIX! A nice gift from Raza and Aryaman Sunil gleefully accepts it. Juicy full toss, around off, Sunil thumps it high and handsome over the long off fence for a biggie.
Starts off with a quicker delivery on middle. Sunil pushes it back towards the bowler.
Sikandar Raza to have a bowl now.

Wellington Masakadza bowls a tight over and concedes just 5 runs off it! Full and in line with the stumps, worked towards mid off for another single. These singles will not do as they are very far from achieving this target.
Full delivery now and wide outside off, Janak Prakash works this wide of mid off for a single.
Fires this one quick into the stumps, Janak Prakash finds the cover fielder.

This one is short as well, and turning away from outside off, Aryaman Sunil goes back in his crease to work this off side, but only manages to mistime it in the air just past the diving cover fielder. They get a single in the process.
Wellington Masakadza serves this one short and wide outside off, Aryaman Sunil hits this well through cover-point for a couple of runs.
Wellington Masakadza fires this one in full outside off, Aryaman Sunil mistimes the shot to the point fielder.
On the shorter side and at the pads, this is turned through mid-wicket for one more.
Flighted this time and around off, Prakash strokes it through covers and picks up a single.
Quicker and flatter, around off, this is nudged away towards backward point.
Aryaman Sunil is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Manpreet Singh finds the only fielder in the deep on the leg side and has to depart! This is tossed up on middle, Singh looks for the slog-sweep and goes after it. Singh gets no timing whatsoever and ends up hitting it flat towards Wesley Madhevere in front of the mid-wicket fence. Wesley Madhevere takes a good low catch and Ryan Burl gets his first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Wesley Madhevere b Ryan Burl

Commentary.Commentary: Around middle and leg, Prakash flicks it away in front of square on the leg side for one.
On the shorter side and on the pads, this is worked away past square leg for a single.
Wellington Masakadza decides to pull his length back and angles it into the pads, Manpreet Singh works this towards square leg for a single.
Manpreet Singh lofts this in the air over the cover fielder. This is full and outside off and Manpreet Singh connects well. The ball falls onto the surface and slows down as the batters take 2 runs.
Wellington Masakadza continues to bowl full and outside off, Hits this past the cover fielder, and takes a brace.
Pulls the length back a bit and delivers it in line with the stumps. Manpreet Singh has to fend this straight back to the bowler.
Full and wide outside off, Janak Prakash knocks this wide of point for a single.
Wellington Masakadza begins with a flighted delivery angled into the pads, Manpreet Singh works this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wellington Masakadza (1-0-9-0) is back on.
On the pads, this is turned through square leg by Singh for one more.
Flatter and on off, Singh can't get it past point.
On a shorter length and on middle, Prakash pushes it off the back foot towards mid on and rotates the strike.
The big boot comes to the aid! Full and straight, Janak Prakash drives it straight, to the right of the bowler who sticks out the right boot and makes the stop.
Fuller again, around off, this is weel driven by Singh towards extra cover for just a single though.
This is the arm-ball, speared into middle and leg, Prakash chips it over mid on and collects a single.
Luke Jongwe bangs this one in and angles it into the batter. Janak Prakash goes for the pull but goes not connect well and gets a single and the ball rolls into the leg side.
This one is wide from off stump and full, Janak Prakash goes for the shot and misses.

FOUR! What a shot to start off for Janak Prakash! He has been highly touted and he has just shown us why! Full and in line with the stumps, Janak Prakash makes rom and powers this past the mid off fieder for a boundary!
Janak Prakash is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Arjun Mutreja gets caught plumb in front and is on his way back! On a fullish length and around off. The ball nips backl in sharply and Mutreja ends up playing all around it. Mutreja misses and gets pinged on the pads. The bowler, Luke Jongwe with a loud appeal and the finger is raised almost instantaneously. Singapore are in a spot of real bother here.
This one is beautifully stroked! Fuller delivery outside off, Arjun Mutreja gets a stride forward and places it to the left of the cover fielder for a couple of runs. Wonderful timing on this shot!
Luke Jongwe bowling good length here just outside off, Arjun Mutreja taps this towards backward point.
Length, at the stumps, this is pushed through mid on for one. 190 needed now off just 72 balls.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is quicker and close to the off pole, Arjun Mutreja tries to cut it away but gets a bottom edge through the keeper's pads and finds the fence.

Appeal for LBW but there seems to be an inside-edge on it. Quicker one, turning in from around off. Singh presses forward and gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards backward point as the batters sneak in a single.
Flatter this time, around off, Mutreja backs away and cuts it past point for a single.
Fuller and quicker around off, Arjun Mutreja looks to squeeze it out but misses.
Starts off with a length ball on off, Singh lofts it through mid off and picks up a single.
Ryan Burl is now into the attack.
Luke Jongwe bangs this one in short and angles it into the batter. Arjun Mutreja goes for the pull shot and misses. A dot ball to end the over and just 3 runs of it.

Goes back to bowling at a good length and in line with the stumps. Manpreet Singh looks to work this leg side and gets a leading edge over the bowlers head and lands between mid off and mid on. The batters take a single and Manpreet Singh is lucky to be there.
Luke Jongwe goes full and quick at the stumps, Arjun Mutreja just about manages to get his bat down in time to dig this out towards mid on for a single.
On a good length once again and just outside off, Arjun Mutreja finds the point fielder.
Angles this one down leg from a good length, probably tickles against the pads as wide as not been called by the umpire.
Luke Jongwe begins with a good-length delivery just outside off, Manpreet Singh taps this towards deep backward point for a single.

FOUR BYES! This one has beaten everyone! Just short of a length from Chatara, over middle and leg. This one takes off after pitching and even the keeper, Regis Chakabva has no chance of getting a hand to it. The ball races away into the fence. At the end of the Powerplay, Singapore are reeling at 36/3!
Arjun Mutreja is the new man in.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Another beautiful piece of bowling by Tendai Chatara and he's got two in the over. Chatara goes a bit wider of the crease and bowls the quick off cutter. The ball pitches on a length and nips back in sharply from around off. Surendran Chandramohan looks to play it off the front foot but the ball goes between bat and pad to hit the top of middle stump. Chandramohan the in-form batter for Singapore departs and they are in a lot of trouble.
Length again, sliding onto the pads, Singh works it away behind square on the leg side for a single.
Nice shape on that one! Goes fuller and a bit wider, the ball shapes away from Manpreet Singh who looks for the explosive cover drive, gets beaten past the outside edge.
Around the top of off, Singh hangs back and edges it down with soft hands towards backward point.
Manpreet Singh is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Tendai Chatara comes back into the attack and straight away gets the breakthrough! This is on a perfect length and in that channel around off. The ball slants away from the left-hander as Aman Desai looks to cover drive. The outside edge is found and Regis Chakabva takes an easy catch behind the stumps. Singapore two down now inside the Powerplay.
Commentary.Howout: c Regis Chakabva b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Tendai Chatara comes back in to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.

FOUR! Surendran Chandramohan gets a hold of this one! This one is flighted full and on middle, the batter gets down the track and lofts it over mid off for a much-needed boundary! Singapore are falling behind on the run rate and need more hits like this to get a move on.
Stump line bowling on a full length. Surendran Chandramohan just manages to fend this towards cover.
Sean Williams continues delivering this full and attacking the stumps, Aman Desai plays this towards mid on for a quick single.
Full and on middle, Aman Desai gets down to sweep and finds the square leg fielder.

Floats this one wide outside off, Surendran Chandramohan goes across the stumps and hits it hard over the infield towards the deep cover boundary! Wellington Masakadza gives chase and stops the ball just before the rope as the batters complete three runs.
Sean Williams fires this full and in line with the stumps, Surendran Chandramohan knocks this towards cover.
Sean Williams to roll his arms now.
Back of a length and around off, Chandramohan opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for one more. Singapore need a lot more than just singles at the moment.
This is banged in short and across the left-hander. Aman Desai throws his hands at it and gets an outside edge over the gully region. The ball goes towards third man as the batters pick up a single.
Length again, around the top of off. Chandramohan hangs back and edges it down to third man with soft hands for a single.
Beaten! Good length, around off and nipping back in off the surface. Chandramohan tries to make room and steer it behind point but gets beaten on the inside edge this time.
FOUR! Full and wide, Chandramohan thrashes it through cover-point and picks up a much-needed boundary.
Ripper of a delivery from Blessing Muzarabani! This is pacy and banged in short, angling towards the helmet. Chandramohan does really well to get his head out of the way.
This is a fraction short and on the legs, Aman Desai can not get past the square leg fielder.
Shorter in length and outside off, Aman Desai hits this hard to the cover fielder.
Wellington Masakadza flights this full and into the pads, Surendran Chandramohan flicks this towards mid-wicket for a single.
Wellington Masakadza pulls the length back slightly and Aman Desai nudges it towards mid on for a single.

FOUR! Easy picking for Aman Desai as he gets off the mark with a boundary! This one is delivered full and in line with the stumps, Aman Desai gets on his knees and lifts the ball into the vacant deep backward square leg region to get his first four runs on the board.
Wellington Masakadza floats this one full and wide outside off stump, Surendran Chandramohan reaches out and gets bat to the ball as he works it through the gap at backward point for three runs.
Early change in the bowling as Wellington Masakadza comes on to bowl.

On a hard length and angling way across the left-hander. Aman Desai looks to pull it away but gets beaten past the outside edge. End of a successful over by Blessing Muzarabani, just 2 runs and a wicket off it.
Back of a length and around off, Chandramohan opens the face of the bat and steers it towards short third man for a quick single.
Aman Desai is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rohan Rangarajan holes out and Blessing Muzarabani picks up a wicket in his very first over. This is a length ball, around the top of off. The pressure of scoring boundaries gets to Rohan as he tries to lift it back over the bowler's head. Rohan gets hurried on and ends up skying it high. The ball swirls around the wide mid on region and Milton Shumba over there takes an exccelently judged catch. Zimbabwe have the early brekathrough they needed.
Commentary.Howout: c Milton Shumba b Blessing Muzarabani

Commentary.Commentary: Pacyn delivery, full and wide, Rohan Rangarajan looks to smash it over extra cover but fails to make a connection.
This is short again on leg stump, Chandramohan hops and works it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Rohan Rangarajan gets hit around the rib cage and is down in some pain. Thankfully, Rohan is up and ready to go.
Leg bye! Starts off with a shortish delivery on the body, Rohan Rangarajan looks to pull it away but misses. The ball hits him on the body and rolls onto the leg side and they sneak in a leg bye.
Blessing Muzarabani to bowl from the other end.

Huge appeal from the bowler as he goes on his knees asking for this wicket! This one is angled down leg from a good length, Surendran Chandramohan tries to work this leg side and gets hit hard on the pads as he misses the line of the delivery.
Tendai Chatara continues bowling wide from the stumps and back of a length. Surendran Chandramohan hit this well past point who manages a half stop and the batters complete a brace.
WIDE! Short delivery wide outside off and continues to shape away. This is out of reach for Surendran Chandramohan to play at and the umpire declares a wide.
Tendai Chatara delivers this on a good length and angled into the middle. Surendran Chandramohan fends this to the right of the bowler.
Serves this one a fraction short and outside off, Rohan Rangarajan guides this  to deep backward point for a single.
This one is on a good length and just outside off stump, Rohan Rangarajan judges the swing well and lets it go through.
Tendai Chatara begins with a back-of-a-length delivery outside off stump. Rohan Rangarajan leaves this one alone. Good carry through to the keeper.
